description.value: Pan Pacific Whistler Mountainside is a full-service luxury hotel located at the base of Whistler Mountain on Sundial Crescent, steps from the Whistler Blackcomb ski and bike park village. Part of the international Pan Pacific Hotels Group, it offers suite-style accommodation in one of BC's premier mountain resort destinations. Touring cyclists finishing or passing through the Sea-to-Sky corridor will find it centrally placed in Whistler Village.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was fetched but the captured content consists almost entirely of global navigation menus and currency selectors, with no property-specific amenity detail for the Whistler Mountainside location beyond a brief notice about exterior enhancements ('We're enhancing the exterior of the property through June'), which confirms the hotel is currently open and operating. OSM provides internet_access=wlan but per rules this cannot be confirmed as authoritative without website corroboration, and the website content does not mention Wi-Fi or any cyclist-specific amenities. No evidence exists in either source for bike storage, laundry, tools, or any other checklist item.
concerns: Fetched website content is almost entirely global navigation boilerplate with no property-specific amenity information; a direct scrape of the Whistler Mountainside property page would be needed to confirm any checklist items.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible luxury hotel in Whistler Village confirmed operating via website notice about ongoing exterior works. Suitable for the directory as overnight accommodation for touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky route.

wow_evidence: Part of the international Pan Pacific Hotels Group

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Pan Pacific slopeside suites at Whistler base; shoulder $300-350
